Projects

04

Bank Customer Churn Dashboard

Personal project · Power BI
  • Built a 3-page interactive dashboard on 10K customer records to diagnose a 20.4% churn rate, with slicers and cross-filtering across segments.
  • Found that Germany churns at ~32% (about 2x Spain and France) and that customers holding 3–4 products churn at 80–100%, a counterintuitive driver.
  • Engineered a composite risk segment in DAX (VAR, SWITCH) separating low-risk (~12% churn) from high-risk (~83% churn) customers; added an ALL()-based measure comparing any segment to the bank-wide average.
Stack: Power BI Desktop · Power Query · DAX
View on GitHub →

Loan Credit Risk Dashboard

Personal project · Power BI
  • Built a 3-page dashboard on ~32K loans ($312M exposure) analyzing default drivers; cleaned data in Power Query (median imputation, outlier removal) and built exposure and loss measures with SUMX and DIVIDE.
  • Showed that 21.8% of loans default but defaulted loans make up 24.7% of dollars lent, so larger loans default more often; loans above 30% of income default at ~65%, 5–6x the rate of loans under 10%.
  • Designed a weighted risk-tier model in DAX and tested it with and without lender-assigned grades: the grade-free High tier isolated a ~78% default pocket from ~12% of loans. Documented limitations (hand-set weights, no holdout data).
Stack: Power BI Desktop · Power Query · DAX
View on GitHub →
